summary: Compute exact degreewise quotient coordinates of the lower- and right-adjoined six-element families for (i,j,p,c)=(2,3,3,2), from complete bounded Pieri relation matrices, and certify the resulting transition blocks by determinants and Smith diagonals.

import itertools
from fractions import Fraction
import sympy as S
from sympy.matrices.normalforms import smith_normal_form

lo=(2,2,2,0,0); hi=(5,5,5,5,5)
def wt(x): return sum(x)
def parts(d, n=5, mx=5):
    out=[]
    def rec(pre, last, rem):
        if len(pre)==n:
            if rem==0: out.append(tuple(pre))
            return
        for z in range(min(last,rem),-1,-1): rec(pre+[z],z,rem-z)
    rec([],mx,d)
    return [x for x in out if all(x[k]>=lo[k] and x[k]<=hi[k] for k in range(n))]
def horiz(lam,mu):
    # lam/mu interlacing criterion for a horizontal strip
    return all(lam[k]<=mu[k] for k in range(5)) and all(lam[k]>=mu[k+1] for k in range(4))
def matrix(d):
    cols=parts(d); rows=[]; labels=[]
    for t in range(1,6):
      for lam in parts(d-t):
        rows.append([int(horiz(lam,mu)) for mu in cols]); labels.append((t,lam))
    return S.Matrix(rows),cols,labels
GL=[(2,2,2),(2,2,2,1),(2,2,2,2),(2,2,2,1,1),(2,2,2,2,1),(2,2,2,2,2)]
GR=[(2,2,2),(3,2,2),(4,2,2),(3,3,2),(4,3,2),(4,4,2)]
# degree sort and coordinate against GL elements of that degree
blocks=[]
for d in range(6,11):
 M,cols,labels=matrix(d)
 gl=[x for x in GL if wt(x)==d]
 gr=[x for x in GR if wt(x)==d]
 gi=[cols.index(x+(0,)*(5-len(x))) for x in gl]
 ri=[cols.index(x+(0,)*(5-len(x))) for x in gr]
 B=M.T.row_join(S.Matrix.hstack(*[S.eye(len(cols)).col(i) for i in gi]))
 C=[]; witnesses=[]
 for q in ri:
    sol,par=B.gauss_jordan_solve(S.eye(len(cols)).col(q))
    assert len(par)==0
    x=list(sol)
    rel=x[:M.rows]; a=x[M.rows:]
    assert all(z.q==1 for z in a) and all(z.q==1 for z in rel)
    C.append(list(a)); witnesses.append([(labels[k],int(rel[k])) for k in range(len(rel)) if rel[k]])
 T=S.Matrix.hstack(*[S.Matrix(c) for c in C])
 det=T.det() if T.rows==T.cols else None
 D=smith_normal_form(T,domain=S.ZZ)
 blocks.append((d,gl,gr,T,det,D,witnesses))
for d,gl,gr,T,det,D,w in blocks:
 print('degree',d)
 print('GL',gl,'GR',gr)
 print('transition rows=GL, cols=GR',T.tolist())
 print('det',det,'smith',D.tolist())
 print('relation-witnesses',w)
# global order requested in natural rho/alpha order stated above
# Assemble transition in order GL and GR listed, grouped degrees
Tbig=S.zeros(6)
for d,gl,gr,T,det,D,w in blocks:
 for a,g in enumerate(gl):
  for b,r in enumerate(gr):
   Tbig[GL.index(g),GR.index(r)]=T[a,b]
print('global',Tbig.tolist())
print('globaldet',Tbig.det(),'globalsmith',smith_normal_form(Tbig,domain=S.ZZ).tolist())
# dominance comparison: partitions ordered by inclusion/dominance; test unitriangular under both natural degree orders
print('diagonal', [Tbig[k,k] for k in range(6)])
print('is_upper_unitriangular', all(Tbig[i,i]==1 for i in range(6)) and all(Tbig[i,j]==0 for i in range(6) for j in range(i)))
print('is_lower_unitriangular', all(Tbig[i,i]==1 for i in range(6)) and all(Tbig[i,j]==0 for i in range(6) for j in range(i+1,6)))
